children: According to Bloomberg, Skydance Corp. is opting out of bidding for US media rights to the next FIFA Men’s World Cup tournaments. Netflix and Fox are eyeing a $4 billion deal. The auction could be among the costliest and most competitive in the global soccer event’s history, people familiar with the matter said.

title: Skydance Exits FIFA Rights Bidding as Netflix, Fox Eye $4 Billion Deal
